coordination.exceptional_wait: Both ReleasableWait overloads swallow OperationCanceledException/ObjectDisposedException and return a wrapper with isReleasable=false. Callers do not test acquisition and continue into their critical section. Mutual exclusion therefore is not guaranteed after cancelled/disposed Wait; Dispose only releases when isReleasable=true.
coordination.heartbeat_limit: AbstractBaseTask.Initialize only calls StartProcess and logs. Transmission.StartProcess stores taskStatus=1 before IPC registration/backlog/timer/connectivity/worker setup; its catch disposes rest/network clients without resetting status. A setup failure after that store is not repaired by the heartbeat status==0 test.
coordination.limits: No file readiness/close handshake from Created notification, no atomic initial-scan/watch handoff, no cross-process filesystem/DB lock in this queue protocol. Actual callback scheduling, writer readiness and OS cross-volume MoveTo behavior remain external. StopExecute/MSK reset and unsent-count queries are not protected by the queue semaphore in AppCommunicationCallback.
coordination.normal: Controller passes one SemaphoreSlimWrapper(1,1) to migration, transmission and disposal. Migration holds it across insert/move/hash/enqueue; live transmission across fresh-row selection and all OperateFile work; backlog across reconciliation and every destination/request; disposal across the entire selected batch. Thus slow synchronous HTTP blocks all these normal holders.
coordination.triggers: Timer and connectivity callback and manual ds_send call the same blocking OperateAccumulatedFiles. Timer Stop/Start reduces its own overlap, not other callbacks. Backlog waits without CancellationToken; cancellation checked per eligible item after reconciliation. Watcher discovery only enqueues, without semaphore, and initial scan precedes enabling Created notifications. Heartbeat checks taskStatus without queue recovery transaction.

external_limits: Crash prefixes are source-derived reachable states assuming preceding operations completed; they are not crash-injection observations or guarantees of power-loss durability.

SQLite permits varchar length overflow and arbitrary boolean/integer values absent CHECK constraints; recorded type names are affinity declarations. No foreign keys, extra unique constraints or queue content-dedup index exist in captured schema.

Remote acceptance, exactly-once semantics and remote hash/idempotency policy require service implementation or authorized fixtures. Client receipt is a local finite history, not remote transaction evidence.
Actual-IL smoke uses original decoded method instructions with inert logger/config and SQLite/filesystem hooks. Hooks do not prove EF provider behavior or Windows event scheduling.

identity.derivative_identity: Decimal-id originals have no extension: gzip appends .gz, Zstandard appends .zst. Recorded compressed_file_path owns a derivative only by exact full-path string; orphan matching does not infer ownership from an id prefix.
identity.duplicate_path: Duplicate validation reads persisted original_hash_value, not newly computed content hash. A receipt hit enters validation-error disposal, without another upload. Receipt tracking is conditional on DoubleTransmissionValidation.DoValidation.
identity.hash_input: lowercase hex MD5(UTF8(lowercase hex MD5(original bytes) + LOCAL salt)); salts are not exported. Compressed integrity uses the same construction over compressed bytes; receipt uses original_hash_value.
identity.migration_input: FileInfo plus configured destination from initial scan/Created event. No persistent discovery record or enqueue deduplication; a repeated stale discovery can insert a row before MoveTo fails.
identity.null_receipt_failure: Bundled EF Core 2.2.4.0 rejects NULL OriginalHashValue during DbSet.Add tracking, before SaveChanges/SQLite: composite key factory returns null when any component is null; NullableKeyIdentityMap.Add throws InvalidOperationException using InvalidKeyValue. SQLite NOT NULL is an additional independent constraint, not the first application failure.
identity.queue_key: process_info.id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT; original is work_directory/decimal(id). Filename, destination, content and unit_id are not queue uniqueness constraints.
identity.receipt_key: (original_hash_value,destination), both NOT NULL, primary key; no unit_id, original filename, compression format or request identifier in duplicate identity.
identity.receipt_window: SelectHashInfo orders UpdatedAt ascending then filters destination. AddHashValue deletes the oldest only when count == limit, commits that deletion separately, then inserts receipt separately. Startup trims while count > limit. Equal UpdatedAt has no secondary ordering. Captured policy limit=100 per destination.

persisted_vs_memory.live_backlog_overlap: A live queue hint can wait while backlog processes the same row first. If backlog saves a future retry_schedule, the later live worker reselects that row but ignores the due time and can send immediately. Semaphore prevents simultaneous normal requests, not this sequential retry-schedule bypass.
memory_only: active request and its returned result
persisted_vs_memory.restart: Controller constructs fresh queues/token/semaphore. Transmission backlog reconciliation runs before monitoring initial discovery. Original hash is set only by migration worker; backlog does not reconstruct a missing hash. Retryable rows bypass age disposal indefinitely; retry_schedule remains the due gate after restart. Live queued items reselect id under semaphore and skip deleted rows, but do not recheck retry_schedule before OperateFile.
persisted_vs_memory.retry_limit_prefix: Retry schedule/is_retryable/attempt count are saved before testing MaxAttempts and terminal cleanup. If interruption follows that save at the limit, restart still selects the due row and can issue another request: there is no pre-request attempt-limit gate. HTTP401 does not increment attempts.

transactions.durability_limit: Completed-call ordering only. EF provider commit/rollback, filesystem rename semantics, disk caches, torn writes and power-loss durability are external. Captured SQLite PRAGMAs describe the opened snapshot, not service connection settings.
transactions.files: MoveTo/Create/Delete and compression are outside SQLite SaveChanges. Gzip opens original Open/Read/FileShare.Read and destination FileMode.Create, CopyTo then disposes gzip/destination/original streams. Zstd also creates/truncates destination before compression and disposes streams. Neither uses temp+rename or explicit Flush(true).
transactions.schema_upgrade: Embedded USER_VERSION_1 = ALTER TABLE process_info ADD COLUMN retry_schedule datetimeoffset. InitializeDatabase calls EnsureCreated first. Existing lower user_version exits without DoMigration; equal accepted, greater throws. New file gets latest version1 via separate PRAGMA. DoMigration closure executes SQL then version PRAGMA separately; InitializeDatabase never invokes it.
transactions.unit: Each helper creates/disposes its own DatabaseContext and calls SaveChanges. Insert metadata, original hash, validation/compressed metadata, retry, receipt eviction, receipt insertion and process deletion are separate calls/contexts.
